create_text_labels: create text labels from detection classes, scores, and class names with crowd annotations
draw_instance_predictions: draw instance-level detection and segmentation predictions on an image with configurable boxes, labels, and masks
draw_box: draw a rectangular bounding box on an image with configurable color, alpha, and line style
visualize_predictions: visualize object detection and segmentation model outputs using CustomVisualizer with args-controlled display options
overlay_instance_masks: overlay instance segmentation masks, bounding boxes, and keypoints on images with color-coded labels
